capabilities: Resolve wikilinks recursively into one document
Generate a -resolved.md copy next to the original note
Detect and report circular link references
Report errors for wikilinks that match no vault file
extras: README states the project is frozen at version 1.0.0 with no further features planned, and that portions of the code and docs were generated with LLM assistance.
problem: Obsidian wikilinks and embeds render linked content in-app but do not produce a single composed Markdown file from a chain of linked notes.
summary: Plugin that recursively resolves wikilinks into a standalone Markdown file, inserting each linked note's contents at the link's location.
